About Zerogah Lab

Where real human experiences fuel AI-driven behavioral understanding

Our Mission

Zerogah Lab exists to bridge the gap between lived human experience and artificial intelligence. By creating a structured, ethical repository of real behavioral narratives, we enable AI systems to understand not just what people do, but why they do it — the triggers, patterns, and psychological mechanisms behind human decisions.

Our Vision

A world where AI truly understands human behavior — not from synthetic data or assumptions, but from the authentic, structured experiences of real people. We envision Zerogah Lab as the definitive behavioral dataset that powers empathetic, insight-driven AI systems worldwide.

Our Methodology

Every experience logged in Zerogah Lab goes through a multi-stage pipeline: structural decomposition (trigger → reaction → consequence → behavioral root), pattern matching across our existing dataset clusters, causal analysis with confidence scoring, and finally synthesis into actionable behavioral knowledge.

How It Works

1

Users log real experiences with structured context

2

AI extracts behavioral patterns and psychological tags

3

Experiences are clustered by pattern similarity

4

Causal analysis identifies root behavioral mechanisms

5

Articles are synthesized from dataset clusters
